Chris: Hey team - I got married this week. Quick Q on next steps for 401(k) and HSA changes.
Chris: Specifically: how do I update beneficiary, change my contribution percent, and does adding a spouse as beneficiary need any vendor paperwork? Also - I have an active 401k loan, will that be affected?
Maya (Benefits): congrats! :tada: You can update beneficiary in the benefits portal. If you want spouse as primary, we usually need a signed beneficiary form if you live in a community property state - check the form link below.
Maya (Benefits): Link: https://benefits.redwood.com/forms/marriage-beneficiary (PDF). For contribution changes, use PayPortal > Elections.
Sam (Payroll): payroll cutoff for a contribution change to hit next paycheck is the 15th at 11:59pm PT. If today is after cutoff it will apply to the following cycle.
Chris: Thanks - what about catch-up contributions (50+) and loan repayment? I expect to change name soon too.
Maya (Benefits): catch-up is an employee election; if you need to start catch-up, add it in PayPortal > 401k elections. For loans: vendor (BrightPlan) continues repayments as scheduled - marriage doesn't stop loan repayments.
Jess (People Ops): For legal name change, send a scanned copy of marriage certificate to benefits@redwood.com and we will push name to payroll and benefits. That typically takes 1-2 pay cycles.
Chris: Is there any special payroll code I should request so the contribution change is processed properly?
Sam (Payroll): Use pay code `MAR-CHANGE-401K` when you submit the change request (notes field in PayPortal). If you email payroll, include subject: "Name/401k change - MAR-CHANGE-401K".
Maya (Benefits): If adding spouse beneficiary and you want spouse to be irrevocable (rare), we need the notarized spouse consent form. Otherwise normal beneficiary form works.
Chris: Got it. Any tax withholding implications for HSA/FSA when changing elections after marriage?
Maya (Benefits): HSA/FSA pretax elections are per-paycheck. If you increase HSA contributions, check the IRS family vs individual max. No immediate extra tax withholding beyond usual payroll calculation.
Benefits Bot: Received: benefits form submission queued (ticket #BP-3245). We will notify you when vendor confirms name update.
Jess (People Ops): Action items for you @Chris - 1) Upload marriage cert to benefits@redwood.com, 2) Submit contribution change in PayPortal before 11:59pm PT on the 15th if you want it next paycheck, 3) Fill beneficiary PDF if adding spouse.
Chris: Thanks all - I'll upload the docs today and submit the election. Appreciated :thumbsup:
Maya (Benefits): ping us if you want help filling the PDF.
Sam (Payroll): noted. I'll watch for the `MAR-CHANGE-401K` note if you email.
Jess (People Ops): closing loop - once vendor confirms, we will update you in this thread.
